verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes a full HTTP API, an SDK (featurebase-js), and webhooks, which allow programmatic/headless interaction with the product outside its UI, and this could be wired into CI/automation pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation, CLI tool, or example showing it running in a CI context or headless automation workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless usage guide, CLI tool, examples of automated pipelines, and independent confirmation of programmatic-only operation.
